name: @reviewer/tui
description: reviewer tui — the review workflow in a terminal: diffs, branches, history and inline comments, drawn with OpenTUI

scripts.build:bin: bun build --compile --no-compile-autoload-dotenv --minify --define REVIEWER_CHECKOUT="\"$(cd ../.. && pwd)\"" src/main.tsx src/diff/highlightWorker.ts --outfile dist/reviewer
scripts.install:bin: bun run build:bin && mkdir -p "${BIN_DIR:-$HOME/.local/bin}" && install -m 755 dist/reviewer "${BIN_DIR:-$HOME/.local/bin}/reviewer" && echo "installed ${BIN_DIR:-$HOME/.local/bin}/reviewer"
